name: 52etf-webmcp
description: 52etf.net 常用经济指标缓存、Crypto链上多空、房地产观测与有效连接汇总 (仅客观数据与连接呈现，不含任何评论或个人资产透露)

capabilities.stale_detection: Items not updated for >180 days (6 months) are highlighted in red (.stale) and listed in /404.txt
capabilities.link_verification: CI runs node scripts/check-links.mjs on every build/schedule and writes unreachable/404 URLs to /404.txt
capabilities.fuzzy_search: Client-side fuzzy search across titles, summaries, #tags, sections, and URLs
